versions.content: Runtime Environment (RTE) The RTE realizes the Virtual Functional Bus (VFB) interface between Software Components (SW-Cs) and connects application components with the Basic Software (BSW). function Rte_Read / Rte_Write [SWS_CP_RTE_00001] Std_ReturnType Rte_Read_<p>_<o>(<data_type>* data); Std_ReturnType Rte_Write_<p>_<o>(<data_type> data); Explicit Sender-Receiver communication API for reading and writing data elements via component ports with transmission status feedback. function Rte_Call [SWS_CP_RTE_00002] Std_ReturnType Rte_Call_<p>_<o>(<in_args>, <out_args>); Synchronous or asynchronous Client-Server invocation across SW-C boundaries or down into BSW service components. function Rte_Result [SWS_CP_RTE_00003] Std_ReturnType Rte_Result_<p>_<o>(<out_args>); Retrieves the response and output arguments for asynchronous Client-Server calls once execution in the server has completed. function Rte_IRead / Rte_IWrite [SWS_CP_RTE_00004] <data_type> Rte_IRead_<re>_<p>_<o>(void); void Rte_IWrite_<re>_<p>_<o>(<data_type> data); Implicit Sender-Receiver communication API ensuring run-time data consistency within a Runnable Entity by snapshotting values at runnable entry and writing back at exit. function Rte_Enter / Rte_Exit [SWS_CP_RTE_00007] void Rte_Enter_<area>(void); void Rte_Exit_<area>(void); Enters and exits an Exclusive Area protecting shared resources from concurrent access by interrupting tasks or runnables.
